key_fields.name: DCLTRANSACTION-TYPE-CATEGORY
key_fields.meaning: DCLGEN host structure for one row of CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY.

key_fields.name: DCL-TRC-TYPE-CODE
key_fields.meaning: Host variable for TRC_TYPE_CODE CHAR(2) NOT NULL - the transaction type code the category belongs to.

key_fields.name: DCL-TRC-TYPE-CATEGORY
key_fields.meaning: Host variable for TRC_TYPE_CATEGORY CHAR(4) NOT NULL - the category code within the type.

key_fields.name: DCL-TRC-CAT-DATA
key_fields.meaning: VARCHAR host group for TRC_CAT_DATA VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL - category description.

key_fields.name: DCL-TRC-CAT-DATA-LEN
key_fields.meaning: Binary length prefix (S9(4) COMP) of the VARCHAR category data.

key_fields.name: DCL-TRC-CAT-DATA-TEXT
key_fields.meaning: Category description text, up to 50 characters.

observations.text: Table qualified with the literal schema CARDDEMO; DCLGEN library comment names a personal dataset (SNJARAO.AWS.DCL).

purpose: DB2 DCLGEN output for table CARDDEMO.TRANSACTION_TYPE_CATEGORY: an EXEC SQL DECLARE TABLE with columns TRC_TYPE_CODE CHAR(2), TRC_TYPE_CATEGORY CHAR(4) and TRC_CAT_DATA VARCHAR(50), all NOT NULL, and the COBOL host structure DCLTRANSACTION-TYPE-CATEGORY. In this module it is included only by COTRTUPC (EXEC SQL INCLUDE DCLTRCAT); it describes the child category rows keyed by transaction type code.
